note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, after 66858fa127). RFC 7606 Section 5.3: "Similarly, the MP_REACH_NLRI or MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute of an update SHALL be considered to be incorrect if any of the following are true:" ... "The length of the MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute is less than 3, or the length of the MP_REACH_NLRI attribute is less than 5." Changed unit TestRFC7606MPUnreachTooShort now asserts the exact description "RFC 7606 Section 5.3: MP_UNREACH_NLRI length 2 < 3", and its doc comment no longer claims length 3 is tested here, naming TestRFC7606MPUnreachMinValid and TestRFC7606MPMinimumLengthsAccepted for the valid side: both minor findings of the previous judgement are closed. Producer read: validateMPAttrLength emits exactly that text with SessionReset, AttrCode 15 and the RFC 4760 Section 7 NOTIFICATION. Both clauses have both polarities at the boundary: negatives MP_REACH 4 (TestRFC7606MPReachLengthFourIsIncorrect, exact "length 4 < 5", code 14) and MP_UNREACH 2 (this unit), positives MP_REACH 5 (FlowSpec, no next hop, so 7.11 cannot interfere) and MP_UNREACH 3 (exact None), plus the wire-level rfc7606-reset.ci (MP_REACH length 2, exact 3/9). Verdict stands.
